input.query: SELECT 'n' p, span_name, attr_span_kind k, count(*) n, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.5)/1e6,1) p50, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.9)/1e6,1) p90, round(max(duration)/1e6,1) mx FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-basic-service' AND attr_span_kind IN ('Internal','Server') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'a', span_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.5)/1e6,1), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.9)/1e6,1), round(max(duration)/1e6,1) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-basic-service' AND attr_span_kind IN ('Internal','Server') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT metric, service_name, round(avg(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN value END),3) norm_avg, round(avg(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN value END),3) abn_avg, round(max(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN value END),3) norm_max, round(max(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN value END),3) abn_max FROM (SELECT 'n' p, * FROM normal_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'a', * FROM abnormal_metrics) WHERE attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-basic-service%' AND metric NOT LIKE 'container.filesystem%' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY metric

SELECT span_name, CASE WHEN duration<50000000 THEN '<50' WHEN duration<200000000 THEN '50-200' WHEN duration<1000000000 THEN '200-1000' WHEN duration<2000000000 THEN '1-2s' ELSE '>2s' END bucket, count(*) n FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-basic-service' AND span_name LIKE 'BasicController%' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CAST(floor((epoch(time)-1754875291)/20) AS INT) bucket, round(avg(CASE WHEN attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-preserve-service%' THEN value END),3) preserve_cpu, round(max(CASE WHEN attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-preserve-service%' THEN value END),3) preserve_cpu_max, round(avg(CASE WHEN attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-travel-plan%' THEN value END),3) tp_cpu, round(avg(CASE WHEN attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-route-plan%' THEN value END),3) rp_cpu, round(avg(CASE WHEN attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-basic%' THEN value END),3) basic_cpu, round(avg(CASE WHEN attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-route-service%' THEN value END),3) route_cpu FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric='container.cpu.usage' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'n' p, metric, service_name, round(avg(value),1) avg_v, round(max(value),1) max_v FROM normal_metrics WHERE metric IN ('jvm.memory.used_after_last_gc','jvm.memory.used') AND service_name IN ('ts-basic-service','ts-travel-service','ts-preserve-service') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'a', metric, service_name, round(avg(value),1), round(max(value),1) FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric IN ('jvm.memory.used_after_last_gc','jvm.memory.used') AND service_name IN ('ts-basic-service','ts-travel-service','ts-preserve-service') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,1
